posts.text:
Thank you!
Unsloth Desktop works on Windows, Mac, Linux + NVIDIA, AMD, Intel GPUs, CPUs, ARM64!

We also support diffusion, video gen + LoRA training, LLM training, RL, decision models, auto compaction, vLLM + SGLang (Windows via WSL), Cloudflared HTTPS, audio, sandboxing + more!

posts.text:
We did a mini update for Unsloth Desktop on running Inkling-2-Mini more smoothly - banded attention got priced correctly, so more context can fit, and we added Dspark detection (2x faster decoding)

Docs at 
https://
unsloth.ai/docs/models/in
kling-2-mini
… also got updated!

posts.author: danielhanchen
posts.name: Daniel Han
posts.text:
Thinking Machines Inkling-2-Mini uses a looped transformer variant that cycles some layers multiple times! It's 5.4B active (inc loops) and  we made some quants for them!

UD3.1 quants retain >90% top-1% accuracy and works in Unsloth desktop!
